description: Delete one Endpoint Storage, to clean up a test one. Exactly one exact name; refused when it still has more pull profiles than max_pull_profiles (default 0: delete them first with edgegap_delete_pull_profile, or raise max_pull_profiles after the developer agreed). Versions that export logs to it stop doing so, so confirm with the developer when the storage is not one this conversation created. The bucket and the logs already in it are not touched. Cannot be undone.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

endpoint_storage.description: The exact Endpoint Storage name to delete.

max_pull_profiles.description: Delete only if it has at most this many pull profiles, which go with it. Default 0.

name: edgegap_delete_endpoint_storage
title: Delete an Endpoint Storage
